title: Panel
description: Discriminated panel response — `type` selects the shape of `config`.

dataAsOf.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the most recent pipeline run that wrote to this panel's bound DataType; null when unbound or never run.

$comment: Per-subtype config shapes live in $defs and are selected via the top-level oneOf below. dataSourceId is not a valid field. A panel is a placement: the `output` kind binds via config.outputId (see OutputConfig) to an Output, which owns the actual data-shaping config (HEL-904); the other kinds (text/markdown/image/divider) carry only their own literal display config.

OutputConfig.description: Config for the `output` panel kind (HEL-904 task 3.6) — a placement of one Output. Everything the five retired bound configs (metric/chart/table/collection/timeline) used to carry (fieldMapping, aggregation, chartOptions, columnWidths/density/columnOrder, timelineOptions, metricId, label/unit) now lives on the Output itself (see schemas/outputs/), not on the placement. Tolerant read: an absent/empty outputId decodes to the empty-string sentinel rather than a validation error; the server still 400s an outputId-less output panel at create/update time.

caption.description: Optional static caption rendered as a strip beneath the image (HEL-318). Absent leaves it unchanged on PATCH; null/empty/whitespace clears it. Omitted from the response config when unset.
